subject.title: WhatsApp: Gemini thinking tags (<think>/<final>) still leak after #6328 fix

question: For strict delivery sanitization, should malformed unclosed reasoning with a later `<final>` boundary recover only the final body, drop the whole malformed block, or be deferred to broader channel delivery policy?
rationale: This choice changes the security/message-loss tradeoff for external channel delivery: preserving too much leaks private reasoning, while dropping too much can hide the intended answer.

options.title: Recover Verified Final Content
options.body: Use the shared sanitizer to keep only content after a real `<final>` or `<final/>` boundary, recursively strip later reasoning, and add WhatsApp/Telegram/shared regressions.

options.title: Fail Closed On Malformed Reasoning
options.body: Drop text after an unclosed reasoning opener unless the runtime has a typed final-answer payload, prioritizing privacy over answer recovery.

options.title: Defer To Broader Delivery Policy
options.body: Keep this issue open under the broader channel delivery semantics work if owners want explicit-send or typed-final routing to solve this class instead of tag recovery.

recommendation.title: Recover Verified Final Content
recommendation.body: Use the shared sanitizer to keep only content after a real `<final>` or `<final/>` boundary, recursively strip later reasoning, and add WhatsApp/Telegram/shared regressions.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for the shared sanitizer fallback and final-tag semantics points to steipete's prior commits in the affected files.
